name: Datarails
summary: Datarails keeps finance teams in Excel while adding budgeting, rolling forecasts, scenario modeling with cycle cloning, and comparisons of actuals with budget or the latest forecast. Plans are quoted: Professional includes 2 users, Premium 5 and Expert 15 plus 50 viewers.

facts.text: The pricing page shows only Request Quote buttons, and its FAQ says exact pricing is not publicly documented.
The variance page says users can compare actuals with budget, with the latest forecast, or year over year.
The pricing page counts 1, 2 and 3 integrations for Professional, Premium and Expert, so connecting more data sources may change the quote.
The site names more than 600 data sources, including NetSuite, Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, Dynamics 365, Salesforce and HubSpot.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Adds spend management (cards, bill pay, contracts)

plans.name: Expert
plans.notes: Adds cash management, month-end close, receivables and a desk module

hiddenCosts: Each plan caps users and integrations, so extra seats or data connections are likely to change the quote.
